GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases .

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plant Growth and Development 1.7 Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reaction.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
